_comment: Hand-maintained. Not overwritten by tools/extract.py. Records typos in the original 1981 text and sections that genuinely do not exist, so lookups fail loudly and correctly instead of silently.

r119.note: e005 evade column reads 'hide r119'. r319 is 'Hide'. There is no r119.

e341.note: Both read 'conversation, see e341'. r341 is 'Conversation'. Events stop at e195.

e250.note: r211 table reads 'Permitted to pay your respects, e250'. e150 is titled 'Pay Your Respects'.

e226.note: r230 raft table, 2d6 roll of 3. e126 is 'Raft caught in Current', the only sensible raft event. Events stop at e195.

_hex_typos_comment: Coordinates the printed text gets wrong. Unlike the section typos above these are not auto-corrected on lookup - they are recorded so a wrong hex is caught when it is read out, and so data/procedures.json can cite why it disagrees with the page.

0801.note: e001 gives caravan destination 3 as 'Ruins of Jakor's Keep (0801)'. The ruins are drawn in 0901; 0801 is empty hills. Confirmed against the map. Matters twice over - it is a starting hex and a 'search ruins' site, and the two hexes are different terrain (mountains vs hills), so the travel row differs too.

nonexistent.r229: The rules booklet states: 'sections r229 and r282-299 do not exist'.
nonexistent.r282-r299: The rules booklet states: 'sections r229 and r282-299 do not exist'.
nonexistent.e167-e179: The events booklet states: 'There are no sections e167 through e179'.
nonexistent.r223-r224: Not an extraction gap: the booklet runs straight from r222 Rest & Healing Wounds to r225 Acquiring Treasure, and nothing in either booklet references r223 or r224. The printed 'does not exist' note covers only r229 and r282-299, so this gap goes unmentioned in the source.

_source_fixes_comment: Literal repairs applied by tools/extract.py before tables are parsed. Kept as explicit find/replace pairs so each is auditable against the printed page. Applied in order; a pair that no longer matches is reported by the extractor. Deliberately limited to short OCR-level tokens - structural defects are handled by rules in tools/tables.py instead, so no substantive game text is stored here.

e067: OCR set the 3 as an e. Rolls 1,2,4,5,6 are all present, so this is die roll 3.

e189.name: Charisma Talisman
e189.note: Referenced as a treasure result but its section is absent from this PDF. e144 describes it as 'a charisma talisman (e189) to walk among them'. Treat as a charm/charisma item and adjudicate by analogy with e182 Gift of Charm if it comes up.

orphan_footnote_markers.e100: The evade column is marked with an asterisk but no footnote was printed beneath the table. The other Griffon note (about its claws) is unrelated. Treat evade as having no special condition.
